name: Meal Planner
description: A weekly meal planner, unique per placement. Space editors lay out breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks across a seven day week, step between weeks, and keep servings and notes on every meal. On its own it is a freeform planner; link a shared recipes table for a recipe picker on each day, and a shared grocery table to send a day's or a week's ingredients straight to the list. Everyone else, including anyone the frame is shared with publicly, sees a live read-only view of the plan. Meals live in encrypted LocalTables scoped to the placement until the owner moves them to shared tables, and every change is pushed live to all viewers.
